sub_questions.question: Can the Team subscription be paid by invoice or bank transfer instead of credit card?

claims.claim: Invoice and bank transfer payment are available for annual Team subscriptions.
claims.guide_evidence: paying by invoice or bank transfer is still being evaluated by Dify and, if it ships, is expected to be limited to annual Team subscriptions only — it is not available on any plan today

claims.claim: The customer can switch the workspace to annual billing on the Billing page.
claims.guide_evidence: Monthly and annual billing are both offered

claims.claim: Invoice can be chosen as the payment method at checkout.
claims.guide_evidence: Payment is by credit card by default; ... it is not available on any plan today

evaluation.rationale: The guide says invoice and bank-transfer payment is still being evaluated and is not available on any plan today. The answer says it is available for annual Team subscriptions and makes up a checkout step for choosing invoice. A finance team could act on this, for example by switching to annual billing expecting to pay by invoice, so the error is a critical billing misstatement.
